description: This file is a CMake script defining a function named GetExternalCode that automates fetching external code repositories (specifically git repositories) during the build configuration process. It includes logic for cloning repositories, checking out specific versions, and handling existing directories.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A function to clone a git repository during the CMake configuration process, with options for specifying repository URL, local source directory, branch/tag/hash, and force removal of existing sources.
